te -tC-SU ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT 5", 2016, by and among by and between Postgraduate Center for Mental Health, having an address at 158 East 35"h Street, New York, New York 10016 (the “Purchaser") and Tammuz, LLC, having an address at c/o Advantage Wholesale Supply LLC, 172 Empire Boulevard, Brooklyn,NewYork11225(the“Seller"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,the Seller is the owner in fee title ofa parcel of land in Bronx,NewYork,known as and by the street address 962WashingtonAvenue,Bronx,NewYork,designated as Block 2368, Lot 9 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Bronx County, and more particularly described inExhibitA-1annexedheretoandmadeaparthereof(saidlandand taxlotbeinghereinafter referred to as the “Seller Land"; the improvements currently existing thereupon as of the date hereof, the “Seller Building” and, the Seller Land and the Seller Building, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the “Seller Property"); and WHEREAS,Purchaser is the owner of fee title in certain land,in Bronx,New York,known as and by the street address 972 Washington Avenue, Bronx,NewYork,designated as Block 2368, Lot 12 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Bronx County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lots being hereinafter collectively referred to as the“Purchaser Land’and, together with any building or improvements placed thereon hereinafter referred to as, the “Purchaser Property"; the Seller Land and the Purchaser Land are herein sometimes jointly.referred to as the"Parcels" and each individually as a "Parcel"); and WHEREAS, the Purchaser intends to construct a new building of approximately 86,000 square and WHEREAS,the Project will contain more floor area than is now available for use under the floor area ratio limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Zoning Resolution") as it relates to the Purchaser Land as an independent zoning lot, with the result that Purchaser and Seller desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for declaring the Purchaser Land and the Seller Land a single zoning lot for the purpose of causing the Project to comply with the limitations contained in the Zoning Resolution. NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good.and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows:

ARTICLEI DECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIONS Section_1.1 The parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith, executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (the “Declaration"), a copy of the Declaration is annexed hereto as Exhibit B and made a part hereof, which seeks to effectuate the intentions of the parties by creating a single zoning lot (herein called the “"Single Zoning Lot") comprising both the Seller Land and the Purchaser Land. ARTICLEII DEVELOPMENTRIGHTS Section 2.1 The Seller hereby transfers and conveys toPurchaser all of the Floor Area Development Rights (as that term is defined in Section 2.3 below) that are appurtenant to the Seller Land, in excess of those which are currently utilized by the Seller Building, and accordingly are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (the “Purchased Amount"),which Purchased Amount of Floor Area Development Rights equals not less than Thirty Nine Thousand One Hundred Fifty Two (39,152) square feet of Floor Area Development Rights that shall be available toPurchaser for its use and incorporation into the Project in compliance with the limitations and restrictions contained in the Zoning Resolution. Section2.2ThePurchasershallbeentitledandauthorized tousethePurchasedAmountofFloor Area Development Rights which arise out of or are appurtenant to the Seller Land and all of the Floor Area Development Rights which arise out of or are appurtenant to the Purchaser Land. If a validly enacted· amendment of the Zoning Resolution increases the Floor Area Development Rights ascribable to all or a portion of the Single Zoning Lot (an “Upzoning"), then such additional Floor Area Development Rights resulting from such Upzoning shall be allocated to thePurchaser Land and shall be available toPurchaserforits use and incorporation intothe Project in compliance with the limitations and restrictions contained in the Zoning Resolution. Section 2.3 As used in this Agreement, the term“Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15,1961(the“Zoning Resolution") as amended,which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures and the term "floor area" shall have the same meaning as ascribed to it in the Zoning Resolution ARTICLE IH LIMITATIONSONSELLERPROPERTY Section 3.01 Seller covenants and agrees that no new buildings, improvements, alterations or additions (each, an “Alteration") shall be constructed on the Seller Land, and no reconstruction, replacement, or rebuilding of substantially the same building as now exists on the Seller Land ("Rebuilding") shall be undertaken of the Seller Building if such Alteration or Rebuilding or any 2
